look: Depth 面板: the DSH composer at night, filling the frame, and the Depth dock rising out of the desk as one precise anodised panel — hairline rules, 8-pixel meter cells, monospaced file badges — the plugin's own slate ground, blue and mint, lit by one cool light from above. Plain.

scenes.name: 原理与效果
scenes.desc: One continuous take: the draft lifts out of the composer and becomes the first finished turn, a hairline forks off into a read-only helper, that panel widens into the Depth dock as it runs, then folds back into the composer as the grounded prompt, and the film signs off.
